# Ports

Every port interface in `pianoanchor.core.ports`, from its KDoc.

## `ClockPort`

Driven port: a monotonic time source in nanoseconds.

All engine timing (matching, grading, scheduling within a session) uses one clock domain. Adapters must never go backwards. Wall-clock time is not provided here. Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.ClockPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `fun nowNanos(): Long` | Current monotonic time in nanoseconds; only differences between readings are meaningful. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/ClockPortContractTest.kt`

## `MidiDiscoveryPort`

Driven port: finding and connecting MIDI devices that are not listed until connected (e.g. Bluetooth LE). Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.MidiDiscoveryPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `fun scan(): Flow<List<MidiDevice>>` | Scans while collected: emits the devices found so far (starting with an empty list), de-duplicated by id, and completes after `Tunables.BLE_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS`. Devices already listed when the scan starts are not included. Fails with [BluetoothUnavailableException] if scanning isn't possible. |
| `suspend fun connect(device: MidiDevice)` | Connects [device], found by a [scan] of this adapter; returns once it is listed in [MidiInputPort.inputDevices] and [MidiOutputPort.outputDevices] under the same id (within `Tunables.BLE_LISTED_TIMEOUT_MS` of opening). While the app runs, the adapter reopens it after a drop (backoff from `Tunables.BLE_RECONNECT_INITIAL_MS` to `BLE_RECONNECT_MAX_MS`, giving up after `BLE_RECONNECT_GIVE_UP_MS`); during a drop the device is not listed. Connecting a device that is already connected and listed does nothing. |
| `suspend fun disconnect(device: MidiDevice)` | Stops reconnecting [device] and closes it if open. No-op if unknown. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/MidiDiscoveryPortContractTest.kt`

## `MidiInputPort`

Driven port: MIDI messages arriving from instruments. Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.MidiInputPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `val inputDevices: Flow<List<MidiDevice>>` | Input devices currently available. Emits the current list as soon as it is collected, then a new list after every change. Never completes. |
| `fun events(device: MidiDevice): Flow<MidiEvent>` | Opens [device] while collected and emits its messages in arrival order, each stamped in the `ClockPort` clock domain with non-decreasing timestamps. Messages that arrive while nobody collects are dropped. Completes normally when the device disconnects; cancelling the collector closes the device. Fails with [MidiDeviceUnavailableException] if [device] is not listed when collection starts. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/MidiInputPortContractTest.kt`

## `MidiOutputPort`

Driven port: MIDI messages sent to instruments (e.g. SysEx requests). Contract: `pianoanchor.testing.MidiOutputPortContractTest`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `val outputDevices: Flow<List<MidiDevice>>` | Output devices currently available; same emission rules as [MidiInputPort.inputDevices]. |
| `suspend fun send(device: MidiDevice, bytes: ByteArray)` | Sends [bytes] to [device]: one or more complete MIDI messages, delivered in order. Completeness is the caller's job; adapters only check the first byte and forward the bytes unchanged. Suspends until the platform has accepted the bytes. |

Contract test: `testing/src/commonMain/kotlin/pianoanchor/testing/MidiOutputPortContractTest.kt`
